title: Koftas - nice ones
preamble:
To include bell peppers, we can make a delicious Turkish-style Adana Kofta.

This version uses finely minced red bell pepper directly in the meat mixture, which adds incredible sweetness, moisture, and color.

500g minced meat (lamb or a beef-lamb mix)

1 red bell pepper (finely minced, liquid squeezed out)

1 small onion (grated, liquid squeezed out)
ingredients: 500g minced meat (lamb or a beef-lamb mix)
1 red bell pepper (finely minced, liquid squeezed out)
1 tsp red pepper flakes (or Aleppo pepper)
